def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find the full-height separator column.
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)))
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]

    shared = set(v for row in left for v in row) & set(v for row in right for v in row)
    base = next(iter(shared))

    out = [[base for _ in range(len(left[0]))] for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(len(left[0])):
            if left[r][c] == base and right[r][c] == base:
                out[r][c] = 3
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Locate the uniform separator row or column.
    sep_row = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    if sep_row is not None:
        first = grid[:sep_row]
        second = grid[sep_row + 1:]
        height, width = len(first), w
        panel_a, panel_b = first, second
    else:
        sep_col = next(c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid))
        panel_a = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
        panel_b = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]
        height, width = h, sep_col

    shared = set(v for row in panel_a for v in row) & set(v for row in panel_b for v in row)
    common = next(iter(shared))

    return [
        [3 if panel_a[r][c] == common and panel_b[r][c] == common else common
         for c in range(width)]
        for r in range(height)
    ]

    return [
